findings.title: Excessive data exposure on current-user profile
findings.description: The current-user profile endpoint returns sensitive server-side fields that should never reach a client, including credential material and internal metadata.
reproduction: Inspect JSON for unexpected fields: passwordHash, internalNotes, role
findings.recommendation: Return a strict DTO with only userId, name, and email (plus any intentional public fields). Never serialize passwordHash, internalNotes, or role by default.

findings.title: Broken object-level authorization on orders
findings.description: An authenticated user can read another user's order by guessing or enumerating the order ID. The API never checks that the order belongs to the caller.
reproduction: Observe 200 and order owned by userId u2, not u1
findings.recommendation: Before returning an order, verify order.userId === authenticated userId. Return 403 or 404 when ownership fails.

findings.title: Broken object-level authorization on user profiles
findings.description: Any authenticated user can fetch another user's profile by ID. There is no ownership or permission check on the :id path parameter.
reproduction: Observe 200 with another user's profile (email: aman@test.com)
findings.recommendation: Allow profile access only for the authenticated user, or enforce an explicit admin/peer permission model. Reject cross-user reads with 403.

findings.title: JWT access tokens never expire
findings.description: Issued JWTs omit the exp claim, so stolen tokens remain valid indefinitely. This weakens zero-trust session controls.
reproduction: Decode the JWT payload (base64url middle segment)
findings.recommendation: Sign tokens with a short exp (and optional refresh flow). Reject expired tokens in auth middleware.

findings.title: Missing rate limiting on authenticated endpoint
findings.description: A rapid burst of authenticated requests completed without 429/503 responses or Retry-After headers, indicating no effective rate limiting.
reproduction: Send 40 rapid GET /orders/mine requests with the same Bearer token
Observe no 429/503 and no Retry-After header
findings.recommendation: Add per-IP and per-user rate limits (e.g. express-rate-limit). Return 429 with Retry-After under abuse.

findings.title: Ownership check on /orders/mine (control)
findings.description: Control case passed. The endpoint filters by the authenticated user and returns only safe fields (orderId, item, amount). No vulnerability reported.
reproduction: Confirm only the caller's orders appear, with no address/userId/password fields
findings.recommendation: Keep this ownership filter as the pattern for other object endpoints.

findings.title: Protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests
findings.description: Unauthenticated probes against protected GET operations were rejected (non-200).
reproduction: Confirm 401/403 rather than a successful data response
findings.recommendation: Keep auth middleware consistent across all tagged secure operations.
